# Public speech QA fixtures

Two public validation recordings from Google FLEURS (`google/fleurs`), licensed
under CC BY 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ . Attribution:
Google FLEURS contributors; Conneau et al., *FLEURS: Few-shot Learning Evaluation
of Universal Representations of Speech* (2022).

Unmodified audio files are paired with their original transcript, dataset row,
permanent dataset-viewer URL and SHA-256 in `fixtures.json`. No private user or
microphone recording is included. These short samples verify actual local
English/Uzbek inference; they are not a broad speech-accuracy benchmark.

Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/fleurs
Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2205.12446
